title: Rotating 3D Globe of Dots
description:
🌍 Interactive 3D Rotating Globe

This project presents a dynamic 3D globe created with 1,000 randomly placed dots, rendered on an HTML5 Canvas.

✨ Key Features:

  • 🔵 Smooth Rotation – The globe continuously rotates around its vertical axis.

  • 📍 Dots Placement – Each dot's position is determined using spherical coordinates and projected into 2D space using perspective transformation.

  • 🏎️ Fluid Animation – Uses requestAnimationFrame to ensure seamless motion.

  • 📏 Responsive Design – The canvas automatically adjusts to window resizing, maintaining proper proportions.

🎯 Ideal For:

✅ Developers and learners exploring 3D graphics and mathematical projections.
✅ Anyone interested in interactive web animations and creative coding.

🔧 Customization Options:

⚙️ Adjust the number of dots, globe size, or rotation speed to experiment and modify the effect!

🚀 Try it out and enhance your web animation skills with this engaging project!
shortDescription: A mesmerizing visualization of a rotating 3D globe made of scattered dots, built using HTML5 Canvas and JavaScript. Perfect for exploring 3D projection and animation techniques.
